crossRefs.note: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with…
then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,

translations.web: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
translations.bsb: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
translations.kjv: VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
translations.asv: VAV. Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.
